# dsh-ui-optimize
English | 中文
A collection of switches that tune how DeepSeek Harness looks and behaves — the whole interface, not
a few named screens. Each switch works on its own, and more arrive as the shell grows.
Today: a **theme gallery** of eight minimalist themes (each defining one palette for light and one f
or dark), **sidebar panel folding** — the panel rows collapse into a single **Panels** entry that op
ens a two-column launcher — and the **desktop Reload/Restart buttons** at the sidebar foot.
Colours travel only through `ctx.theme.overrideTokens`, as a single layer of theme variables. No str
uctural CSS is injected and no other plugin's DOM is read, so an upstream redesign can at worst make
the colours inert — it cannot break the layout.
## Install
Install `@moonsand/dsh-ui-optimize` from the GUI plugin manager. Requires `engines.dsh >= 0.2.1-rc.3
stall `@moonsand/dsh-ui-optimize` from the GUI plugin manager. Requires `engines.dsh >= 0.2.1-rc.3`.
## Use
Open **Settings → UI Optimize**.
### Themes
Celadon, Linen, Cream, Graphite, Indigo, Slate, Sage, Rose. Picking a card recolours the whole inter
face; **Default** restores the stock look. Every theme defines one palette for light and one for dar
k — switching Appearance between them carries the theme along, so there is no separate version to pi
switching Appearance between them carries the theme along, so there is no separate version to pick.
### Desktop actions
Two switches control the sidebar-foot buttons:
- **Reload UI** — reloads the page and client plugins only; the Host and running tasks keep going. *
*Desktop app only**: browser shells such as fnOS already ship their own refresh entry, so this switc

h stays off there and cannot be turned on
- **Restart app** — restarts the whole app including its H
ost; interrupts the current conversation. **Desktop app only**: a browser session does not own the p
rocess that would have to be restarted
### Sidebar
A switch folds the panel rows in the left rail into a single **Panels** entry. Clicking it opens a t
wo-column launcher with the panel icons, a title and count, a search box once there are more than se
ven panels, and keyboard control (↑ ↓ to move, Enter to open, Esc to close). Panels that register la
ter — including ones added by other plugins — are picked up on the next open, so nothing silently di
sappears from the list.
The entry calls the shell's own panel-selection API instead of synthesising clicks. A watchdog measu
res the folded row after mount and on every resize: if it cannot be measured, the switch turns itsel
f off and the native sidebar comes back rather than leaving an empty rail.
The **More** row keeps its own line. Folding it in was tried and dropped: the shell's overflow menu
only opens from a trusted click, which a plugin cannot produce, and the synthetic pointer events tha
t came close also closed the launcher through the shell's click-outside handler.
The launcher follows the pattern of the community plugin dsh-sidebar-shelf: register a real rail row
, hide the rest with one scoped CSS rule, enumerate entries through the slot API, and select a panel
through the shell's own API rather than by faking clicks.
## Known limitations
- The theme choice lives in browser `localStorage`; it is lost with the browser profile or site data
- Reload and Restart are **desktop-app only**: in a browser both switches are disabled and the side
bar-foot buttons are not rendered at all — the fnOS shell already provides its own refresh and resta

rt entries
- The restart action is a process-level operation that cannot be verified automatically

## Development
[代码示例省略，未执行]
The smoke test covers the assembly contract only: the three runtime files parse, the theme table is
complete (8 themes × 10 tokens × 2 schemes), and the published identity plus `engines.dsh` are intac
t. It does **not** check whether the palettes look right or whether the sidebar launcher opens.
